target: 559 Collaborator Eximius

source: After making his decision, Lumian had a chance to inquire, “Who’s the suspect?”
target: Postquam consilium cepit, Lumian occasionem habuit rogandi: “Quis est suspectus?”

source: “Lato Guiaro,” the Knight of Swords announced.
target: “Lato Guiaro,” inquit Eques Gladii pronuntiavit.

source: Lumian recognized this individual.
target: Lumian hunc cognovit.

source: He was also a committee member of the Fisheries Guild.
target: Etiam membrum Collegii Piscariorum erat.

source: Not only did he own shares in three large fishing boats and the Port Santa Fisheries Company, but he was also involved in shipbuilding, ice production, and other industries.
target: Non solum partes in tribus navibus piscatoriis magnis et in Societate Piscaria Portus Santa possidebat, sed etiam in navium fabricanda, glacie producenda, aliisque industriis versabatur.

source: Someone in his family had already married a Maiden of the Sea over a hundred years ago.
target: Aliquis ex familia eius iam ante plus quam centum annos Puellam Maris in matrimonium duxit.

source: Lumian asked thoughtfully, “What’s Lato Guiaro’s connection to Balançat Ship Rental?”
target: Lumian quaesivit cum cogitatione: “Quae est relatio Lati Guiaro ad Balançat Ship Rental?”

source: “He’s a creditor of the company and has arranged employment for many relatives there,” the Knight of Swords replied succinctly.
target: “Creditorem societatis est et plurimos cognatos ibi munivit,” respondit Eques Gladii succincte.

source: “It all adds up.” Lumian nodded in agreement and paused to reflect.
target: “Omnia conveniunt,” annuit Lumian, et pausavit ut consideraret.

source: “Let’s convene at the crossroads of Saint Lana Street and Golden Wheat Street. How about meeting in three minutes?”
target: “Conveniamus ad intersectionem viae Sanctae Lanae et viae Tritici Aurei. Quid de conventu post tres minuta?”

source: He had never set foot in Lato Guiaro’s extended family estate, so he lacked the corresponding spirit world coordinates.
target: Numquam in praedium familiae extensae Lati Guiaro ingressus erat, itaque notae mundi spirituum ei defuerunt.

source: His only teleportation option was Saint Lana Street, relatively close to their target.
target: Unica eius via translocationis erat via Sanctae Lanae, quae ad metam proxime sita erat.

source: He needed to utilize Spirit World Traversal discreetly to evade any surveillance.
target: Oportuit ut per transitus mundi spirituum caute uteretur, ne ullam vigiliam attraheret.

source: “Sure.” The Knight of Swords dissolved into transparency and disappeared instantly.
target: “Certe.” Eques Gladii in transparentiam dissolutus statimque evanuit.

source: Lumian spent two minutes hydrating, donning a vest and a straw hat.
target: Lumian duos minutas aquam sumendo, tunicam et petasos stramineos induens egit.

source: Only then did the faint glow of the black mark on his right shoulder illuminate.
target: Tunc tantum leviter fulgor atri notae in dextro humero eius lucebat.

source: In an instant, his figure vanished from the shrouded room.
target: In momento, eius figura ex conclavi occulto evanuit.

source: At the crossroads of Saint Lana Street and Golden Wheat Street, Lumian materialized from a concealed corner.
target: Ad intersectionem viae Sanctae Lanae et viae Tritici Aurei, Lumian ex angulo occultato apparuit.

source: The Knight of Swords, now sporting disheveled brown hair, a switched flaxen-colored shirt, and a dark brown vest, stood at the fringe of the crimson moonlight.
target: Eques Gladii, nunc cum capillis fusco inconditis, camisiae flavae mutatae, et vestimento fusco obscuro indutus, ad limitem lunae rubri stetit.

source: His pallid face and oppressive eyes hinted at an underlying transformation, as if he could shed his human guise at any moment, revealing a monstrous form fueled by pent‑up desires.
target: Vultus eius pallidus et oculi opprimi insinuebantur de transformatione subiecta, tamquam quovis momento vestem humanam amittere posset, monstram formam ex desideriis repressis efferens.

source: While others might miss these subtleties, Lumian, being an Ascetic, possessed a heightened sensitivity to such situations.
target: Dum alii has subtilitates praetermittere possent, Lumian, asceta, sensibilitatem exquisitam ad tales casus habebat.

source: The temperance faction, indeed… Lumian mused at the Knight of Swords’s appearance, entertaining a whimsical thought.
target: Temperantiae factionem, certe… Lumian de specie Equis Gladii meditabatur, animum leviter ad rem levem concipiens.

source: Bro, ever considered embracing Inevitability? As an Alms Monk or an Ascetic, you’d spare yourself from enduring so much!
target: Frater, numquamne cogitasti fatum inevitablem amplecti? Ut monachus eleemosynarius aut asceta, te ipsum a tanta cruciatu liberabis!

source: Of course, Lumian merely toyed with the idea and wouldn’t actually propose it.
target: Certe, Lumian solum cum illa cogitatione lusus est, et re vera id proponere non voluit.

source: Without the right strokes of luck, the boon of an evil god could gradually corrupt Beyonders within the potion system, eventually transforming them into humanoid monsters aligned with the evil deity.
target: Nisi bona fortuna adsisset, donum dei mali paulatim Beyonders intra systema pocionis corrumpere poterat, eos tandem in monstra anthropomorpha ad deum malum consociata transformans.

source: Nevertheless, his musings hinted at the potential synergy between specific Sequences of the boon system and potion system.
target: Attamen, eius cogitationes indicabant potentialem synergiam inter certas sequentias systematis doni et systematis pocionis.

source: “Let’s proceed.” As the Knight of Swords remained silent, Lumian took the lead and spoke.
target: “Procedamus.” Cum Eques Gladii tacitus maneret, Lumian duxit et locutus est.

source: The Knight of Swords nodded, and they followed the shadows along the street, turning into Golden Wheat Street at a measured pace, heading north.
target: Eques Gladii annuit, et se umbras per viam secuti sunt, quae in via Tritici Aurei, gradu moderato, conversabatur, ad septentriones.

source: Soon, they reached a five‐story building resembling a small castle.
target: Mox pervenerunt ad aedificium quinque tabulatum, quod parvo castello simile videbatur.

source: Observing the illuminated windows and grayish‑blue outer walls, the Knight of Swords pointed at a specific glass pane, noting,
target: Intuens fenestras illuminatas et parietes exteriores griseo‑caeruleos, Eques Gladii ad particularem vitrum ostendit, dicens:

source: “That’s Lato’s bedroom. He and his wife sleep in separate rooms.”
target: “Id est cubiculum Lati. Ipse et uxor eius in separatis cellis dormiunt.”

source: The gathered intelligence is impressively detailed… Lumian acknowledged silently and inquired, “What’s your plan?”
target: Intelligentiae collectae singulariter accuratae sunt… Lumian tacite agnovit et quaesivit: “Quid consilium tuum?”

source: “Sneak in and take control of the target,” the Knight of Swords responded succinctly.
target: “Intrā furtim et propositum occupa,” respondit Eques Gladii succincte.

source: Isn’t that a bit too straightforward and crude?
target: Nonne id paulo nimis apertum et crassum non est?

source: The Guiaro family likely employs more than just ordinary Beyonders.
target: Familia Guiaro verisimiliter plus quam ordinarios Beyonders adhibet.

source: Some members may have gained powers through the sea prayer ritual…
target: Nonnulli membri fortasse virtutem per ritum preces maris adepti sunt…

source: Lumian recalled the unique characteristics of a Wraith and assessed his capabilities.
target: Lumian singularia umbrae revocavit et eius facultates aestimavit.

source: With one hand in his pocket, he casually remarked, “Okay.”
target: Una manu in sinu positam, leve dixit: “Bene.”

source: With those words, his form dissolved into a shadow, seamlessly merging with the darkness.
target: His verbis, eius figura in umbram dissoluta est, cum tenebris perfecte coniungens.

source: Beside him, the Knight of Swords had already vanished.
target: Apud eum, Eques Gladii iam evanuerat.

source: Utilizing the shadows cast on the building’s outer wall, Lumian deftly infiltrated Lato Guiaro’s room.
target: Utens umbris in pariete exteriore aedificii proiectis, Lumian callide in cubiculum Lati Guiaro invasit.

source: In an instant, his target came into view.
target: Instante, propositum eius apparuit.

source: A middle‑aged man, with slightly curly black hair and dark brown eyes, adorned in a dark‑blue cotton robe, greeted Lumian’s sight.
target: Vir medii aetatis, capillis nigeris modice crispis et oculis fusco brunneis, in veste caerulea ex cotone indutus, Lumianum salutavit.

source: His long face featured a neatly trimmed thick beard.
target: Facies eius longa barbam spissam ac rite concisam ostendebat.

source: Lato Guiaro’s expression morphed into one of fear, and his body froze.
target: Vultus Lati Guiaro in formam timoris versus est, et corpus eius immobilis factum est.

source: He stumbled toward the shadow concealing Lumian.
target: Procidit ad umbram quae Lumian abscondebat.

source: In the reflection within each eye of the Fisheries Guild committee member, Lumian spotted the pale‑faced Knight of Swords, clad in a dark brown vest and flaxen‑colored shirt, with disheveled brown hair!
target: In speculo, quod in singulis oculis membri Collegii Piscariorum apparuit, Lumian equitem gladii, cui vultus pallidus, vestis fusca et camisia flava erant, cum capillis brunneis inconditis, conspexit!

source: Observing Lato Guiaro losing control of his body, unable to utter a sound, Lumian stepped out of the shadow, returning to his original form.
target: Observans Lato Guiaro corpus suum imperium amittere et nihil pronuntiare posse, Lumian ex umbra processit, ad formam suam originalem rediens.

source: An oppressive heaviness enveloped the air around him, akin to the weight of seawater.
target: Gravis onus opprimens, sicut pondus aquae maris, aerem circa eum complectebat.

source: Apart from this, nothing seemed amiss.
target: Praeter hoc, nihil aliud anomale apparuit.

source: With a controlled step, Lumian approached Lato Guiaro, a sensation akin to moving through a swamp.
target: Cum gradu moderato, Lumian Lato Guiaro accessit, cum sensu quasi per paludem ambularet.

source: He refrained from resorting to the direct use of the Spell of Harrumph.
target: Ab directamine usu Incantationis Harrumph cohibuit.

source: Firstly, the other party seemed powerless and could be managed through alternative means, saving his spiritual energy.
target: Primum, adversarius impotens apparuit et per alios modos regeri poterat, ita energiam spiritualem servans.

source: Secondly, Lumian hesitated due to uncertainty about whether the Spell of Harrumph would incapacitate both of them, given the forceful possession of Lato Guiaro by the Knight of Swords.
target: Secundo, Lumian haesitavit, incertus utrum Incantatio Harrumph utrumque eorum incapacitet, dato quod Lato Guiaro a Eques Gladii vim fortiter possidebat.

source: Retrieving a bottle of sedative from the Bliss Society, Lumian unscrewed the cap and brought it to Lato Guiaro’s nose.
target: Ex Societate Beatitudinis, Lumian lagunculam sedativam obtulit, operculum solvens atque ad nasum Lati Guiaro duxit.

source: Fanning the opening with his hand to hasten the gas’s flow, after about ten seconds, the committee member of the Fisheries Guild closed his eyes and slumped into unconsciousness.
target: Excitans aperturam manu ad accelerandum flumen gasii, post circiter decem secundos, membrum Collegii Piscariorum oculos clausit et in inscientiam cecidit.

source: Remarkably, he remained standing, not collapsing to the ground.
target: Mirum quidem, mansit stans, neque in terram corruit.

source: The Tarot Club’s Minor Arcana card holder, the Knight of Swords, maintained absolute control over Lato Guiaro’s body.
target: Tenens cartam Minor Arcana Taroti, Eques Gladii absolutum imperium super corpus Lati Guiaro retinuit.

source: This is even simpler than employing teleportation and the Spell of Harrumph… I’ve faced numerous Beyonders before, but never have I subdued one without laying a hand on them.
target: Hoc quidem etiam simplicius est quam teleportationem et Incantationem Harrumph adhibere… Multos Beyonders ante aggressus sum, sed numquam aliquem sine tactu meo vinctum fecerim.

source: I strolled up casually, administering the sedative.
target: Casualiter ambulavi, sedativum applicavi.

source: A Wraith truly stands as an exceptional ally, capable of harmonizing with any Sequence of any pathway…
target: Umbra vere stat ut socius eximi, qui quacumque sequentia cuiusque itineris congruentiam efficere potest…

source: Yes, a Wraith remains impervious to anesthetic gasses.
target: Ita, umbra immunis gasorum anestheticorum manet.

source: The Bliss Society’s sedative had no effect on him.
target: Sedativum Societatis Beatitudinis ei nullum effectum habuit.

source: As Lumian observed the noiseless resolution, he almost felt as if he hadn’t partaken in the skirmish at all.
target: Dum Lumian quietam solutionem spectabat, paene sensit quasi in proelio omnino non interfuisset.

source: He returned the Bliss Society sedative to his concealed pocket and retrieved a canister of truth serum.
target: Sedativum Societatis Beatitudinis in sinum occultum reddidit et phialam serum veritatis abstulit.

source: Seizing the moment, he administered nearly a third of it to Lato Guiaro.
target: Momento capto, fere tertiam eius partem Lato Guiaro infudit.

source: Sensing that the sedative’s impact might be short‑lived on Beyonders with unknown traits like Lato Guiaro, he hastened to complete his preparations before the target regained consciousness.
target: Sentiens effectum sedativi breviter perseveraturum esse in Beyonders speciebus ignotis ut Lato Guiaro, festinavit praeparationes absolvere, priusquam meta iterum conscie fieret.

source: Within 20 to 30 seconds, Lato Guiaro’s eyes fluttered open.
target: Inter viginti ad triginta secundos, oculi Lati Guiaro subinde aperiti sunt.

source: First, he encountered Louis Berry, the adventurer in the golden straw hat, adorned with a faint smile.
target: Primum convenit Ludovicum Berry, viatorem cum petaso stramineo aureo, leviter risu ornatum.

source: Subsequently, he discovered himself seated on a chair at some indeterminate moment, facing the divan in the bedroom.
target: Postea se invenit sedens in sella aliquo tempore incerto positus, frontaliter ad divanum in cubiculo spectans.

source: Lato attempted to scream, but his vocal cords rebelled, rendering him motionless.
target: Lato clamare conatus est, sed chordae vocis eius recalcitraverunt, eum immobilis reddentes.

source: “Have you grasped your situation?” Lumian reclined on the sofa, placing his right foot on his left knee.
target: «Intellexistine condicionem tuam?» inquit Lumian, reclinatus in sofa, pedem dextum super genu sinistrum ponens.

source: He spoke in Intisian.
target: In Intisiano locutus est.

source: Fear etched across Lato’s face, rendering him unable to nod or respond.
target: Timor in facie Lati incisus est, faciens ut neque annueret neque responderet.

source: While he possessed certain abilities, Lato was certain they wouldn’t suffice against the adventurer Louis Berry.
target: Etsi certas facultates habebat, Lato certus erat illa non sufficere adversus viatorem Ludovicum Berry.

source: They would likely result in a renewed coma or a swift lightning strike.
target: Probabiliter illa ad novam comam aut ictum fulmineum celerem convertentur.

source: “What do you want?” Lato suddenly inquired.
target: «Quid vis?» Lato subito quaesivit.

source: He, too, knew Intisian.
target: Et ipse Intisian sciebat.

source: Attempting to raise his hand in surprise to touch his neck, he found himself immobilized.
target: Conans manum ex stupore elevare ut collum attingeret, se invenit immobilis.

source: Lato Guiaro lapsed into silence.
target: Lato Guiaro silentio cecidit.

source: With a smile, Lumian responded, “I have a few questions for you. Answer them satisfactorily, and I might consider letting you live until tomorrow to assist me in spreading the word about this affair.”
target: Cum subrisu, Lumian respondit: “Nonnullas quaestiones tibi habeo. Illis satis responde, et fortasse te ad diem crastinum vivere permittam, ut mihi in huius rei divulganda auxilies.”

source: Lato remained silent for a moment before consenting, “What do you want to know?”
target: Lato parum silentium tenuit, deinde assentiendo, “Quid vis scire?”

source: Lumian casually shook his right ankle.
target: Lumian leviter tarsum dextro concussit.

source: “Are Nolfi and Batna with you?”
target: «Num Nolfi et Batna te comitantur?»

source: “Yes,” Lato responded with a strong inclination to divulge information.
target: «Ita,» inquit Lato, forte promptus ad informationem divulgandam.

source: “They’re locked up in the basement. They’re still alive. I just want to use them.”
target: «In cella subterra celati sunt. Adhuc vivunt. Illos solum uti volo.»

source: “For what?” Lumian inquired, intrigued.
target: «Ad quid?» inquit Lumian, curiosus.

source: Lato’s lips trembled as he explained, “I intend to use them to lead you to the location of the sea sacrificial ritual and guide you to rent a boat there.”
target: Labia Lati tremuerunt dum explicabat: “Intendo eos uti, ut te ad locum ritus sacrificii maris ducam et te ad navem ibi conducere moneam.”

source: “So, you’re the one who wrote that note…” Lumian exclaimed in realization. “How do you plan to guide me?”
target: “Ita, tu es qui illud nota scripsisti…” exclamavit Lumian cum intellectione. “Quomodo me ducere cogitas?”

source: Lato struggled to articulate his actions, but his mouth moved faster than his thoughts.
target: Lato conatus est verba exprimere, sed os eius celerius quam cogitationes movebatur.

source: “I want you to discover that Nolfi and Batna intend to rent a boat and head out to sea. Then, I’ll arrange for them to seize an opportunity to escape and relay something to you, letting you know the significance of the sea area.”
target: “Volo ut cognoscas Nolfi et Batna navem conducere atque in mare proficisci intendere. Deinde disponam ut occasionem capiant ad effugiendum et aliquid tibi tradant, ut significationem regionis maris tibi inducant.”

source: “And then?” Lumian inquired with curiosity.
target: “Et deinde?” inquit Lumian, curiosus.

source: Lato sealed his lips shut but eventually spoke.
target: Lato labia sua cohibuit, sed postremo locutus est.

source: “What they will tell you is the truth, but they are unaware of one thing: “Never engage a Child of the Sea in a sea battle! Juan Oro awaits you in that sea region, ready to bury you entirely!”
target: “Quod tibi dicent, verum erit, sed unum nesciunt: ‘Nunquam puero maris in proelio marino incumbas! Juan Oro te in illa regione maris exspectat, paratus te omnino sepulturam dare!’”

source: So, the Fisheries Guild planted a deceptive trail through the clue about Nolfi, posing as a turncoat to lure me into a trap and eliminate me…
target: Ita, Collegium Piscariorum vestigium fallax per indicem de Nolfi posuit, se pro proditore praetendens, ut me in laqueum alliceret et deleat…

source: If I hadn’t swiftly revealed my intent to investigate the sea prayer ritual, exposing Nolfi and Batna to exploitation, they might already be sleeping with the fishes…
target: Nisi celeriter propositum meum de investigatione ritus orationis maris revelavero, Nolfi et Batna ad exploitationem patefieri, iam fortasse cum piscibus quiescerent…

source: The skirmish against Lugano was crafted to deceive me…
target: Pugna adversus Lugano ad me decipiendum parata erat…

source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, he heard Lato express confusion, “You haven’t even started your investigation. How did you find me? You merely sent your interpreter to inquire about Nolfi and the others’ whereabouts. There was no follow-up…”
target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani festinabant, audivit Lato dicere: “Investigationem tuam quidem ne coepisti. Quomodo me invenisti? Interpretrem solum misisti ut quaereres de locis Nolfi et ceterorum. Postea nihil secutum est…”

source: Lumian’s smile held a cryptic undertone as he disclosed, “Do you think I’m here alone to investigate the sea prayer ritual?”
target: Risus Lumiani subtextum arcani habuit, dum declaravit: “Putasne me solum hic esse ad investigandum ritum orationis maris?”

source: “I represent the will of many. Numerous comrades lurk in the shadows of Port Santa.”
target: “Voluntas multorum me repraesentat. Numerosi sodales in umbris Portus Santa latent.”

source: Lato felt a chill course through his stiffened body, lending credence to Lumian’s words.
target: Lato frigus per corpus rigidum suum percusit, dictis Lumiani corroborans.

source: Lumian raised his right hand and stroked his chin.
target: Lumian dextram manum levavit et mentum suum carexit.

source: “Where does your power come from?”
target: “Unde tua potentia provenit?”

source: Lato’s throat constricted as he answered, “From the sea. Each sea prayer ritual grants us strength.”
target: Guttur Lati contraxit, cum respondit: “Ex mari. Quisque ritus preces maris vires nobis tribuit.”

source: “Unfortunately, the ritual failed last year. We received no replenishment for two years, and everyone weakened to varying degrees. Otherwise, Juan Oro would have finished you long ago. He would have cast your lifeless form into Wave Square, a stark warning to those who cross us!”
target: “Infeliciter, ritus anno praeterito defecit. Biennium nullam repletionem accepimus, et omnes ad diversos gradus infirmati sunt. Alioquin, Juan Oro te iam pridem conficeret. Te in Forum Undarum sepulceret, ut acerbum monitum illis qui nos oppugnant daret!”

source: Similar to a boon? Theoretically, even without replenishment, a boon’s power will gradually wane… Lumian pondered for a moment and remarked,
target: “Simile dono? Theoretice, etiam sine repletione, vis doni paulatim decrescet… Lumian paulisper meditatus dixit,”

source: “The sea prayer ritual is a large‑scale boon‑seeking ritual, with the Governor of the Sea as the primary sacrifice?”
target: “Ritus orationis maris est amplus ritus donum quaerens, cum Gubernator Maris ut principale sacrificium fungatur?”

source: Lato contemplated for a moment before responding, “He serves as both sacrifice and host. Juan Oro and we act as assistant hosts.”
target: Lato paulisper contemplatus respondit: “Ille ut sacrificium et hospes fungitur; Juan Oro et nos ut hospites adiutores agimus.”

source: “The sea prayer ritual is essentially a marriage to the sea and appeasing it. The boon is a byproduct.”
target: “Ritus orationis maris essentia matrimonium cum mari et eius appeasatio est; donum autem effectus secundarius est.”

source: “Marriage to the sea?” Lumian suddenly found his imagination lacking.
target: “Matrimonium cum mari?” inquit Lumian, repentinus quod imaginationis eius deesset.
